What Makes Our Bollywood Shows Unique

🎭

Theater-Trained Professionals

All dancers trained in classical Indian dance (Kathak, Bharatanatyam) with contemporary Bollywood specialization. Experience performing at 5-star hotels, international events, and Bollywood film backup dancing. Male and female dancers available for couple/group choreography.

🎵

Live Music Excellence

Not pre-recorded tracks—real musicians playing live with authentic Bollywood vocals. Fusion with Rajasthani folk instruments (sarangi, nagada, khartal) creates unique soundscapes. Our singers mimic original Bollywood playback artists.

👗

Bollywood Glamour

Authentic Bollywood costumes featuring lehengas, sherwanis, and contemporary fusion attire. Multiple outfit changes during performances with sparkle, sequins, and stage-ready aesthetics that photograph beautifully.

🎉

Audience Engagement

Interactive segments where guests learn easy Bollywood steps and join on stage. Photo-ops with dancers in full costume. Surprise bride/groom integration into choreography for wedding celebrations.

🌍

Cultural Bridge

Bilingual hosting (English/Hindi) makes performances accessible for international guests. Context provided for folk elements and cultural significance. Entertainment that celebrates Indian culture while being universally enjoyable.

✨

Versatility & Customization

From intimate 50-guest sangeets to 500+ festival stages—we scale seamlessly. Custom song selection with 3+ weeks notice. Theme integration (retro 70s Bollywood, romantic ghazals, high-energy Bhangra, regional folk).

Frequently Asked Questions

Do you only perform in Pushkar?

No! We regularly perform throughout Rajasthan including Jaipur, Ajmer, Udaipur, Jodhpur, and beyond. Travel charges apply for venues 50+ km from Pushkar. We’ve also performed in Delhi, Mumbai, and Goa for destination events.

Can you perform songs we specifically request?

Absolutely! Share your song list when booking. We can choreograph custom performances for your favorite Bollywood tracks with 3+ weeks advance notice. Our repertoire includes 200+ songs, and we’re always learning new ones.

What if our venue doesn’t have a stage or sound system?

We bring portable sound systems suitable for venues up to 200 guests (included in package). For larger events, we coordinate with the venue’s technical team or arrange professional sound rental (additional cost). Performances work in both indoor and outdoor settings.

How much space do dancers need to perform?

Minimum 15×15 feet for 4-6 dancers. For larger troupes (10+ dancers), we need approximately 20×25 feet. We’ve performed on hotel ballroom stages, outdoor lawns, palace courtyards, and resort poolsides—we’re very adaptable.

Can family members or guests join the performance?

Yes! We love including special guests. Popular options include: bride/groom surprise entry choreography, parent-child duet segments, or “teach the audience” portions where everyone learns a hook step together. Makes for amazing photos and videos!

What genres besides Bollywood do you perform?

We specialize in Bollywood but integrate Punjabi Bhangra, Rajasthani folk (Ghoomar, Kalbeliya), Sufi fusion, and regional styles. Our strength is blending these genres seamlessly—it’s Bollywood with authentic cultural depth.

Do you provide costumes or do we need to?

All dancer costumes are included in our package pricing. We have an extensive wardrobe featuring traditional lehengas, contemporary fusion attire, and themed costumes. You don’t need to provide anything—we handle all costuming.

Can you perform at outdoor venues?

Yes! We’ve performed at beach weddings, palace courtyards, resort lawns, rooftop terraces, and desert settings. We bring portable lighting for evening outdoor shows and always have weather backup plans coordinated with your venue.

What’s your cancellation policy?

50% deposit is non-refundable once choreography work begins. Cancellations 30+ days before event: 75% refund of remaining balance. Within 30 days: deposit retained. Rescheduling within the same season: no additional charge (subject to availability).

Do you offer payment plans?

Yes! For bookings made 3+ months in advance: 25% at booking, 25% one month before event, 50% on event day. All payments accepted via bank transfer, UPI, PayPal, or cash.

Can you integrate our brand or event theme?

Absolutely! For corporate events, we can incorporate brand colors into costumes, mention company names in hosting segments, and even choreograph to custom jingles or theme songs. Share your vision and we’ll make it happen.

What’s the difference between your packages?

Main differences are duration, number of dancers, and production scale. Sangeet Special (4-6 dancers, 1.5hr) suits intimate gatherings. Grand Celebration (8-10 dancers, 2hr) is our most popular for destination weddings. Festival Spectacular (12-15 dancers, 3hr) is full theatrical production for large events.
